scope: I checked every section of the Korean manuscript (Ⅰ–Ⅶ). Results directions were cross-checked against the anonymous English Methods/Results/Discussion/Conclusion. Three supplied original PDFs were read in full: NN-CES, RTCAKENN and EPED. Other citations were checked only against the supplied source audits.
verdict: Largely consistent. Result directions match the English original: the four designs carry equal weight; F and L5 are separated; staleness means the age of the history, not a forecast horizon; and NN-CES coupling, a CNN comparison and Stage 2 are all correctly framed as unperformed. Only two material corrections are needed: an EPED physics misstatement, and one result sentence missing its validation-design qualifier.

critical_findings.old_exact: 장벽이 넓어질수록 같은 기울기로 더 높은 꼭대기에 닿는다.
critical_findings.new: 장벽이 넓어질수록 허용되는 꼭대기 높이는 커지지만, peeling-ballooning 한계는 폭에 대해 선형보다 느리게 증가하므로 최대 안정 기울기는 오히려 줄어든다.
critical_findings.why: EPED states that the PB height bound scales roughly as width^(3/4). The maximum stable gradient therefore decreases as the barrier widens. 'Reaching a higher top at the same gradient' contradicts the source.
critical_findings.evidence_locator: EPED PDF p3, §1.1 last paragraph; PDF p4, Fig.3 caption

critical_findings.old_exact: 같은 표에서 양측 GP의 중앙값 절대오차는 추정기보다 약간 낮다.
critical_findings.new: 무작위 설계에서 양측 GP의 중앙값 절대오차는 추정기보다 약간 낮다.
critical_findings.why: The original states the median-absolute-error comparison only for the random design. Without the qualifier, the sentence overgeneralises a design-specific result across all designs.
critical_findings.evidence_locator: English Discussion 'Reading' ('under the random design its median absolute error is the higher one'); Results §res:best
